dialogues.speaker: Nusta
dialogues.text: #Used to it already, eh, {NICKNAME}? We've got Melusines and Asha joining our teams of dancers this time. Look at them go. Gives you a real cozy feeling, doesn't it?

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Ahaha! That's the spirit! Unleash that passion and rock your body to the beat!

choices.text: Could I have a word real quick, Nusta?

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Oh yeah, sure. First off, I've got good news—

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Previously, I visited the Collective of Plenty to improve my boxing skills and enhance my core strength...

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: ...And I wound up taking the chance to practice playing the drums. Pretty good at it nowadays, if I do say so myself!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Master Iansan says that if I further improve my double pedaling and compound rhythms, I'll be able to play even more avant-garde pieces.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: So, if you're looking to put a crew together and can't find a drummer...

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: I'd be up to help — if you'll have me, of course!

choices.text: It seems we're missing some friends this time, aren't we?

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Hmm? Oh! You mean Taraneh and Uncle Scimitar?

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Ah, it's a shame, but they've been super busy lately.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Something insane happened in Sumeru, and a huge relocation project was carried out in response.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Fortunately, I've heard that the danger has passed, and that they've moved back to where they used to live.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Moving's always a massive hassle, never mind if you've got to do it twice. Gotta sort your things, clean the house... Yeah, that stuff takes time.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: And given their personalities, I wouldn't be shocked if Taraneh and Uncle Scimitar went to help others out once they'd settled their own business.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: So instead, we've got some of the Blazing Beasts, who're having a rather relaxed time.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: I have no doubt that they'll be the first to show up next time, though. I'll have the wine ready for them — already do, in fact!

choices.text: I'll swing by for a dance later.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: No problem! Feel free to try the awesome food we've got at the party. Nothing like getting in the mood for a jig first, right?
